scripts.android:sync: vite build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: vite build --mode release && npx cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew bundleRelease
